conditions_stated.value: Testable long rule as he describes it: (1) bullish higher-timeframe bias; (2) price trades down into equilibrium/discount of the range and sweeps sell-side (a lower low below a prior low); (3) optional SMT divergence ES vs NQ; (4) a 1m break of structure up; (5) enter on the retrace into the 1m FVG, stop under the post-sweep low, target the day's high / buy-side liquidity. Wed: a 15m imbalance at equilibrium alone was not enough, because the price action was choppy and there was no sweep.
conditions_stated.ref: Built from the Monday drawings (#26-#35: two circled lows, red BOS line 5,514.75, grey FVG, long position box) and heard [06:30] 'right to silence the liquidity your brain structure' ['sweep the liquidity, break structure'], [11:45] 'maybe you wanna wait until ... balance' ['equilibrium'], [16:15] SMT, [18:00] 'not even a suite of liquidity' ['not even a sweep of liquidity'], [19:15]-[19:30] 'fifteen minute imbalance ... looks great ... however this price action looks like shit'.

Entry 5,513.50 (grey label) ≈11:07. Stop ≈5,508 (±0.5; box bottom, no label), under the post-sweep higher low. After entry the low was ≈5,512.7, so the stop was not hit. Price reached ≈5,534 at ≈12:45, ≈5,537 at ≈14:18 and ≈5,539 (±1) near ≈15:55. Whether 5,539.25 traded is undeterminable. He calls it 'all in hindsight'.

Wed 3 Jul NQ 15m/1m LONG idea (not taken): a pre-open range 20,207.25-20,295.75 with a 15m imbalance 20,228.50-≈20,249 at/below the 0.5 (20,251.5). At ≈09:30 price jumped ≈20,213 to ≈20,264 and pulled back into the zone ≈20,235 (≈09:32-09:35). It held ≈20,247-20,249 into ≈10:25, then broke 20,296 ≈10:40 and reached ≈20,340 by ≈11:00.
